roast.description: Set update rate, RoR calculation, and chart data during a live roast.

roast.fcStartDescription: BT at which First Crack is auto-marked
roast.autoChargeDescription: Charge is triggered when BT drops by this amount within the detection window.

roast.alertSoundDescription: Beep when an alarm first triggers.
